description_en: Queries the specifications of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的规格配置
name: DescribeInstanceSpecs

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the IDs of instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

InstanceSpecs.description_en: The details of the specifications of the instance
InstanceSpecs.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的规格配置列表

BaseBandwidth.description_en: The basic protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s

ConnLimit.description_en: The specification of concurrent connections of the instance
ConnLimit.description_zh: 实例的并发连接数规格

CpsLimit.description_en: The specification of new connections of the instance
CpsLimit.description_zh: 实例的新建连接数规格

DefenseCount.description_en:
The number of available advanced mitigation sessions for this month. -1: unlimited

This parameter is returned only when the request parameter RegionId is set to ap-southeast-1. If RegionId is set to ap-southeast-1, the specifications of Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instances are queried
DefenseCount.description_zh:
本月可用高级防护的次数。-1表示无限次。


只有当请求参数RegionId为ap-southeast-1（表示查询DDoS高防非中国内地实例）时，才会返回该参数

DomainLimit.description_en: The number of domain names that can be protected by the instance
DomainLimit.description_zh: 实例可防护域名的数量

ElasticBandwidth.description_en: The burstable protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s

ElasticBw.description_en: The burstable clean bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s

ElasticBwModel.description_en:
The metering method of the burstable clean bandwidth. Valid values:

day: the metering method of daily 95th percentile
month: the metering method of monthly 95th percentile
ElasticBwModel.description_zh:
实例的弹性业务带宽的计费模式。取值：

day：表示日95计费模式。
month：表示月95计费模式

ElasticQpsMode.description_en:
The metering method of the burstable QPS. Valid values:

day: the metering method of daily 95th percentile
month: the metering method of monthly 95th percentile
ElasticQpsMode.description_zh:
实例的弹性QPS的计费模式。取值：

day：表示日95计费模式。
month：表示月95计费模式

FunctionVersion.description_en:
The function plan of the instance. Valid values:

default: Standard
enhance: Enhanced
cnhk: Chinese Mainland Acceleration (CMA)
cnhk_default: Secure Chinese Mainland Acceleration (Sec-CMA) standard
cnhk_enhance: Sec-CMA enhanced
FunctionVersion.description_zh:
实例的功能套餐类型。取值：

default：表示标准功能套餐。
enhance：表示增强功能套餐。
cnhk：表示加速线路。
cnhk_default：表示安全加速线路标准功能。
cnhk_enhance：表示安全加速线路增强功能

PortLimit.description_en: The number of ports that can be protected by the instance
PortLimit.description_zh: 实例可防护端口的数量

RealLimitBw.description_en: The threshold of the clean bandwidth. Valid values: 0 to 15360. The value 0 indicates that rate limiting is never triggered. Unit: Mbit/s
RealLimitBw.description_zh: 实例业务带宽限速值。取值：0～15360，0表示不限速。单位：mbps

SiteLimit.description_en: The number of sites that can be protected by the instance
SiteLimit.description_zh: 实例可防护站点的数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
